featured_reviews.review_text: I had such a wonderful experience with the customer service at Shinde Shoes in Gorai Charkop, Borivali West. The staff really care about what their customers want. While I was window shopping, I came across a gorgeous pair of shoes that I couldn't stop thinking about. But when I went back the next day to buy them, they were no longer available at the store. I tried searching for them on various online platforms but had no luck. So, I decided to visit Shinde Shoes again and showed the staff a picture of the shoes. They went out of their way to help me track them down through their network. Within minutes, they found the store where the shoes were in stock and promised to get them for me. Sure enough, within just four days, the shoes were ready for me to pick up. I was really impressed with how dedicated and helpful the team at Shinde Shoes was

featured_reviews.name: Lavy Pinto
featured_reviews.review_text:
*Please train your staff to be honest, open, and forthcoming with the information on offers and such*.

This review is specific to our visit to the Mochi outlet at Sky City Mall on 15.12.25.

We were there to shop for sandals.  We were attended by Mohd Aaman Salauddin Ansari.  Everything went well until the billing.  We asked the sales person if there was any ongoing discount. He said there wasn't, and after looking at the screen for a while, got up and brought us a small bottle of ZeOLite foot spray saying this will be free for you. There was some discrepancy in the billing amount and the MRP of the sandals I had bought. He couldn't clarify it.

Later when we checked the Mochi website we found out that there was 11% discount on the sandals.  Then we looked at the E-bill ( which takes a while to come) and realised what the salesperson had done!
Instead of telling us about the discount, he had made us force buy the product we didn't want or need.

I'd like to feel happy at the end of any shopping experience. Here I felt duped, which is not the kind of shopping experience we usually get in an outlet like Mochi.

Please train your staff to be honest, open, and forthcoming with the information on offers and such.   I would like to return the foot spray and get my money back.

Of late they don't deliver,  that is my experience.  I purchased sandals in Jan 2024 and had to go back (within a very short  period of time) due to the defect found in it.  Some portion of sole started tearing off and had to give it back.  With great pride, they declare that l can get the refund, but l have to make a new purchase of the same amount or more. Amazing surprise. Everyone is aware that you have to cough up some more money. I had requested to give me a similar pair (it was available in the shop) but they refused to give me funny reason.
So,  l purchased a fresh pair of sandals on Mar 17th. After noticing that a lower portion of the sole  lost its grip and started getting separated. This happened in a FRESH pair of sandals.

Again, l returned it back on April 22, 2024, for replacement. This happened in TWICE in a very, very short period of time (Jan 2024 to April  2024).

I have gone through a lot of hardship & difficulty as both  the new pairs of sandals gave me shoe bites at different places in my both feet.

So,  l will remember this in the future before stepping into the Woodland shoe shops.
I am going to write a detailed mail to the customer care with a high expectation.  Let's see what happens after that.
